# xcelsior_pricing (Data Source)

The published rate card. Rates are per GPU-hour in millionths of `currency`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xcelsior_pricing" "rtx4090" {
  gpu_model = "RTX 4090"
}

output "rtx4090_on_demand_per_hour" {
  # Rates are in millionths of data.xcelsior_pricing.rtx4090.currency.
  value = data.xcelsior_pricing.rtx4090.rates[0].on_demand_per_hour_micros / 1000000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `gpu_model` (String) Only this GPU model (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency the rates are settled in.
- `rates` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rates))

<a id="nestedatt--rates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rates`

Read-Only:

- `gpu_model` (String)
- `on_demand_per_hour_micros` (Number) On-demand rate. Null when the GPU has no such rate.
- `reserved_1mo_per_hour_micros` (Number) Rate under a one-month commitment. Null when the GPU has no such rate.
- `reserved_1yr_per_hour_micros` (Number) Rate under a one-year commitment. Null when the GPU has no such rate.
- `reserved_3mo_per_hour_micros` (Number) Rate under a three-month commitment. Null when the GPU has no such rate.
- `spot_per_hour_micros` (Number) Spot rate. Null when the GPU has no such rate.
- `vram_gb` (Number)
